definitions.explanation: The price the seller names, before any haggling. Usually used when the buyer either accepts it without negotiating or complains that it is too high.

examples.english: I bought it at the asking price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言|い}い{値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have no intention of simply paying the other party's asking price.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}い{値|ね}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{交渉|こうしょう}→交渉：02727_koushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦そのまま→そのまま：03322_sonomama⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいない。
examples.english: At the market, negotiation starts from the asking price, so nobody pays it as it stands.

notes:
The stem of ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price): the price that is said. Do not confuse it with the ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧ of social-media "likes", which is written in kana.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言|い}い{値|ね}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧: to buy at the asking price
- {言|い}い{値|ね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the asking price
- {言|い}い{値|ね}⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧: exactly as quoted

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{付|つ}け{値|ね}→付け値：30527_tsukene⟧: bid price — the price the buyer offers, the counterpart of {言|い}い{値|ね}
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧: list price — the fixed retail price, not open to negotiation
